Ruen Nuad Massage Studio

A hidden teak-house gem on Silom's Convent Road

Bangkok/Massage/Ruen Nuad Massage Studio

About

Tucked inside a restored teak house near Convent Road, Ruen Nuad offers superb traditional Thai massage in an atmospheric heritage setting. Consistently rated among Bangkok's best-value quality massages — book ahead.

Ruen Nuad 隐藏在是隆运河路附近一栋修复的柚木老宅中，在充满历史氛围的环境里提供一流泰式按摩。常年被评为曼谷性价比最高的优质按摩馆，建议提前预约。
